title: NASA NSSDC Planetary Fact Sheet (metric)
transformation: Manual transcription of four columns into CSV with uniform units. Earth, Moon, Venus and Mars. Planetary fact-sheet summary rounded values. Pressure for Mars displayed as 0.01 bar, rounded.
not: Not spacecraft raw telemetry or an active NASA API; no live ephemerides.
note: For irradiance use NASA individual planetary fact sheets: https://nssdc.gsfc.nasa.gov/planetary/factsheet/venusfact.html ; https://nssdc.gsfc.nasa.gov/planetary/factsheet/marsfact.html ; https://nssdc.gsfc.nasa.gov/planetary/factsheet/moonfact.html
